lines.text: When Jesus arrived, Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb, and Bethany was near Jerusalem.
Martha went out to meet Jesus while Mary stayed home, and Martha said she believed He was the Christ.
Martha called Mary aside, and Mary quickly went to Jesus and fell at His feet.
Jesus came to the tomb, a pit with a stone across the entrance, and told them to take the stone away.
Jesus called out, "Lazarus, come out!" and the dead man came out with his face wrapped in a cloth.
